text:
Rae: Quick idea  run a compact PLG launch: 25-min "Quickstart Play" webinar + 30 starter credits + 3 one-click prompt templates. Hypothesis: combo increases 72h active by ~20%.
Liam: Love it. Primary metric: % new signups with >=2 successful gens within 72h. Secondary: ttfs, gen_count_7d.
Priya: Cohorts: control | credits_only | webinar_only | combo. Need control. Baseline ~11% -> target ~13.2% (20% rel). Power calc says ~1.5k/arm for 80% power.
Marta: Traffic plan: product banner + blog + Discord + small paid push to devs. Use utm: ?utm_source=banner&utm_campaign=play_launch&arm=combo.
Rae: Prompt set: "Short outreach", "Feature brainstorm (3 bullets)", "Data -> 1-paragraph insight". Keep examples runnable and <80 tokens.
Liam: Landing microcopy test: H1A "Try the Quickstart Play: credits + ready prompts" vs H1B "Reserve the quickstart webinar + get credits". CTA test too.
Priya: Tracking fields: signup_source, promo_pool, promo_code, webinar_reg, first_gen_ts, gen_count_72h, ttfs, retention_d7. QA with two staging accounts.
PromoBot: Promo pool created: play_launch_pool (3500 codes). API: POST /promo/assign {user_id,pool} -> {code,expires_at}. Single-use, expiry 14 days. Auth: service token.
Marta: Add 1-click "Run sample" on landing for logged-in users, otherwise show curl snippet:
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-1","prompt":"Summarize product in 2 lines"}'
```
Rae: Webinar format: 15m demo, 7m walkthrough of templates, 3m CTA to claim credits + templates. Include tiny benchmark slide (tokens/cost/latency).
Liam: Add micro-eval: 5 gold prompts to sanity check template outputs across two model families; target >=80% acceptability.
Priya: Owners: Marta - landing & social narrative (draft Wed); Rae - experiment brief & webinar script (Thu); Liam - metrics/analysis plan (Fri); PromoBot - codes & integration (Fri). Weekly sync Tue 9am PT.
Marta: I'll draft two social narratives: technical (benchmarks) and PM-friendly (time saved). Keep claims factual.
Rae: Great. I'll post the experiment doc link here when it's live. :rocket:
